classifiedFinding.title: collectReward with zero totalStaked silently leaks funder value: rate is anchored but the depletion clock does not advance

classification.assetImpact: Funder deposits during zero-staked periods are not distributed in the advertised window; either parked or windfall to next entrant. No funds lost outright, but value-allocation deviates from intent.
attackPath: 3. rewardPerSecond is set against the full depletionDuration, but _updatePool early-returns (totalStaked == 0), so no actual depletion occurs until a stake arrives.
4. First subsequent staker may receive an outsized windfall, or value remains parked depending on timing.
classification.likelihood: low — requires the unusual collision of funder activity with zero TVL; in practice funders fund after stakers are present
classification.assumptions: Zero totalStaked at moment of collectReward call
classification.externalRequirements: Funder calls during a zero-TVL window (operational anomaly)

classifiedFinding.justification: Value-allocation defect with very narrow trigger conditions (zero TVL + funder action). No principal loss; rewards eventually distribute (or are donated to next entrant). Distinct from V1 rate-recompute KI but adjacent. The realistic-likelihood is low because protocols typically attract initial stakers before funding cycles. Demoted to Low/QA.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-medium. Classifier downgrades to Low because: (a) trigger requires unusual zero-TVL+funding overlap, (b) no direct fund loss — value redistributes between protocol actors with no clear victim. QA with note to revert collectReward when totalStaked == 0.
